official_name.value: Ecole de Management de Normandie (EM Normandie)

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Excel agreement scope specifies 'Business Administration' major/field rather than an AUC school code.

instruction_languages.notes: Undergraduate and graduate programmes offered fully in English or fully in French.

english_course_availability.notes: Undergraduate and graduate business tracks available fully in English across campuses.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: For English-taught programmes (waived for native English speakers; home university certificates accepted): UG requires CEFR B2 (TOEFL iBT 72, IELTS 5.5, TOEIC 750); GR requires CEFR B2 (TOEFL iBT 83, IELTS 6.0, TOEIC 790). RHET 1020 waiver not mentioned.

host_language_requirement.value: French CEFR B2 (DELF/TCF scores) required only for French-taught programmes; waived for English-taught tracks and native speakers.

fall_term_dates.value: Fall semester: Early September to late December (exams included; exact dates vary by chosen programme and campus).

spring_term_dates.value: Spring semester: Early January to April/May (exams included; Year 3 students start late January; exact dates depend on programme and campus).

tuition_model.notes: Official EM Normandie exchange guidelines confirm nominated partner exchange students are exempt from EM Normandie tuition fees (free-movers pay EUR 3,500-4,000/semester).

est_monthly_living_local.notes: 2024-25 Fact Sheet p.3 lists monthly expense estimate for primary campus Le Havre (and Caen) as approx. EUR 800/month. Other campuses listed on p.3: Paris approx. EUR 1,200/month, Oxford approx. GBP 1,000/month, Dublin approx. EUR 1,600/month, Dubai approx. EUR 1,700/month.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: Le Havre primary campus EUR 800.00/month * 5 months = EUR 4,000.00; converted at ECB 2026-11-13 rate (collected 2026-11-15) 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html) = 4,420.80 USD (higher for Paris/Dublin/Dubai campuses).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: In France, French Social Security registration is mandatory and free of charge (EU students bring EHIC; supplementary private coverage recommended, promo code 76EMN-10 for Studcorp/Heyme). UK/Ireland/UAE campuses require local/home private medical insurance or UAE residence permit insurance. Optional Student Concierge Club membership is EUR 150 for 6 months.

housing_availability.notes: No on-campus dormitories; EM Normandie partners with Studapart online housing platform (accessible once school login is issued; email accommodation@em-normandie.fr).

housing_notes.value: No on-campus housing offered; students use the Studapart housing platform partnered with EM Normandie (property owners, student residences, agencies) once admitted.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: EM Normandie issues an official acceptance letter upon complete application for visa purposes (Campus France / Etudes en France and VLS-TS long-stay student visa apply for non-EU students in France; UK/Ireland/UAE rules vary by chosen campus).

exchange_page_url.notes: Confirmed live exchange programmes & 2026-27 course offer downloads hub.

course_catalog_url.notes: Hosts downloadable 'Course Offer - Exchange & Free Movers Students 2026-27' and Road Map PDFs.

english_course_list_url.notes: Course offer PDFs include English-taught undergraduate and graduate business tracks.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS credit system; minimum requirement of 15 ECTS credits per semester for exchange students.

course_restrictions_note.value: Access to the 6 campuses (Le Havre, Caen, Paris, Dublin, Oxford, Dubai) depends on study level; students may change campuses during a full-year exchange (except dual-degree).

value: Language certificate from home university or TOEFL/IELTS/TOEIC/DELF/TCF scores
required_application_docs.notes: Language certificate rule on p.2; full document checklist provided inside online application portal.

campus_type.notes: 6 campuses across Caen, Le Havre, Paris (Clichy), Dublin, Oxford, and Dubai.

international_support_services.value: International Affairs team (incoming@em-normandie.fr), Studapart housing support (accommodation@em-normandie.fr), complimentary French classes for English-taught programmes, and optional Student Concierge Club.
international_support_services.notes: Concierge Club and Studapart details on p.3.

nomination_deadlines.value: 2024-25 Fact Sheet: Fall/Full Year nomination Apr 15, application Apr 30; Spring nomination Oct 15, application Oct 31 (later cycles note up to May 15/30).
